units: Tosef. Mikv. III, 1 a pit שגָּלַת ed. Zuck. which was left open.—Part. pass. גָּלוּי open, revealed.
<cite ref="Shabbat 55a:8">Sabb. 55ᵃ</cite> <he>ג׳ וידוע וכ׳</he> it is open and known to me.

senses.gloss: (of a place) to become bare of inhabitants (v.
units: Jud. XVIII, 30; Jer. I, 3); (of the inhabitants) to leave home, go into exile. Y. Taan. I, 64ᵃ top בכ״מ שגָּלוּ … גָּלַת וכ׳ whithersoever Israel went as exiles, the Divine Majesty went with them (ref. to נגלה, I Sam. II, 27); Meg. 29ᵃ; a. e.—Pesik. Haḥod. p. 48ᵃ אם ג׳ אחד מכם … כאילו גְּלִיתֶם כולכם if one of you is banished (by the Roman Government) to &c.: … as though ye all had been banished; Pesik. R. s. 15; Cant. R. to II, 8.
<cite ref="Arakhin 12a">Arakh. 12ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Megillah 11b:8">Meg. 11ᵇ</cite> <he>גָּלוּ בשבע</he> they were transported to Babylonia in the seventh year (after the subjection of Jojakim).
<cite ref="Mishnah Makkot 2:1">Macc. II, 1</cite> <he>אלו הן הַגּוֹלִין</he> the following (involuntary homicides) have to leave for the city of refuge.
<cite ref="Mishnah Makkot 2:1">Ib.</cite> <he>אינו גוֹלֶה</he> is not bound to flee to &c. Ib. 3 <he>האב גולה ע״י הבן</he> a father is banished for killing his son; a. fr.
<cite ref="Makkot 12b:8">Macc. 12ᵇ</cite> <he>היו … מַגְלִין וכ׳</he> the Israelites executed the law of banishment in the desert.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 23">Num. R. s. 23</cite>, end.
<cite ref="Ruth Rabbah, Petichta 1">Ruth R. to I, 1</cite> <he>ומַגְלָם מארצם</he> and is the cause of their exile &c.; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 12:6">Koh. R. to XII, 6</cite> (play on <he>גלת</he> <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 12:6">ib.</cite>) ‘the golden bowl’ is the gullet, <he>שהיא מַגְלָה את הזהב ומריצה וכ׳</he> (not <cite ref="U00304"><he>שהיה</he></cite>; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 18:1">Lev. R. s. 18</cite> <he>שמכלה</he>, corr. acc.) which banishes the gold and makes the silver run, i.e. which impoverishes the glutton.

senses.gloss: to be discovered, exposed to view; to reveal one’s self, appear. Tanḥ. Sh’moth 19 נ׳ עליו בקולו וכ׳ He revealed Himself to Moses with the voice of Amram &c.; Ex. R. s. 3.
units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 2">Ex. R. s. 2</cite>, end <he>בכ״מ שהשכינה נִגְלֵית</he> wherever the Divine Glory appears.

senses.gloss: to uncover, remove; to discover, reveal, publish.
units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 15:22">Ex. R. s. 15</cite>, beg. <he>גִּלּוּ הצדיקים וכ׳</he> the righteous uncovered their heads.

<cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 5:2">Sot. V, 2</cite>; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 21:7">Gen. R. s. 21</cite> <he>מי יְגַלֶּה עפר וכ׳</he> Oh that one would remove the dust from over thy eyes, i.e. Oh, that thou wouldst resurrect!; Y. Ber. IX, 13ᵈ bot.—
